signing: ad-hoc integrity signatures; no Developer ID or Apple notarization
qualification: first public testing release; production qualification remains incomplete
known_limitations: Whole-wrapper realtime and lifecycle ownership work remains open; audio dropouts or host-specific behavior may occur.
An extreme transform setting has a recorded DC-offset issue; keep monitoring low and avoid high output gain.
State recall stores parameters and restarts phases and empty tape; captured audio is not saved.
Native Intel hardware, older macOS versions, accessibility, long soaks and broad DAW compatibility remain unqualified.
Windows, Max for Live and hardware downloads are not included in this release.
